description: Enterprise product tier: ticket IDs PROJ-<n>, named approver and release manager, CODEOWNERS; agent commits per work item on task branches and never merges

profile.OWNER: Scenario Owner (product owner); approvals and releases by the roles in docs/ENTERPRISE.md
profile.AGENT_MAY_COMMIT: Per work item on a task branch
profile.BRANCH_POLICY: Task branches named task/<ticket-id>-<short-description>; main is protected
profile.COMMIT_CONVENTION: Subject starts with the ticket ID, for example "PROJ-42: Add export"
profile.AGENT_REMOTE_POLICY: Never; approvers review and merge pull requests
profile.CODEOWNERS_AND_BRANCH_PROTECTION: `.github/CODEOWNERS`; main is protected and needs one approval
